### Intro to data graphs {.unnumbered}




**Some notation**: $X_i$ is the $i^{th}$ entry of vector $\mathbf{X}$ and $\mathbf{X}_{\mathscr{N_i}}$ is the sub-vector of $\mathbf{X}$ which contains entries related to person $i$'s network exposure units. Where the original vector already has a subscript, we append these symbols to that subscript.
